items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we got that bass – Leo Fender brought it to Monk just before we went to Europe in 1953... Monk started playing it. We got criticized in Paris by all the critics.

ctx.x: . . . the electric Fender bass, because we got that bass – Leo Fender brought it to Monk just before we went to Europe in 1953. Nobody knew who the hell it was. It’s louder. Monk started playing it. We got criticized in Paris by all the critics.
